name: shield
description: A medieval shield standing on its lowest point with its face to +Z: a curved (heater, kite) or domed (round) plank board, a painted field in one of four colours or bare wood, a gold cross or quartered charge, an iron or rawhide rim, iron studs, an optional iron boss, and a leather handle and batten on the back.

params.name: height
params.description: Height of the shield in metres; the diameter of a round shield.

params.name: widthRatio
params.description: Width of a heater or kite shield as a share of its height.

params.name: curve
params.description: How much the board curves (a heater and kite curve round the body, a round shield is domed).

params.name: boss
params.description: An iron boss (umbo) in the middle; usual on a round shield.

params.name: rim
params.description: An iron rim round the edge (otherwise a thin rawhide edging).

params.name: scheme
params.description: Colour of the field: 0 = blue, 1 = red, 2 = green, 3 = black, 4 = bare wood.

params.name: emblem
params.description: Gold charge on the field: 0 = none, 1 = a cross, 2 = quartered.

params.name: studs
params.description: Number of iron studs round the face (in pairs).
